question: Below which mutation rate do three strategies in cyclic dominance stop coexisting at fixed frequencies and start to cycle?

provenance.source: J. Hofbauer and K. Sigmund, Evolutionary Games and Population Dynamics (Cambridge University Press, 1998); M. Mobilia, J. Theor. Biol. 264, 1 (2010)

name: three strategies in cyclic dominance with mutation

carrier.name: frequencies x and y of two strategies; the third has frequency 1 - x - y

closure: well-mixed population of constant size, so that the frequencies sum to one; sampling in a finite population enters as noise
observable: the frequencies of the three strategies
assumptions: replicator dynamics with payoff a for a win, -b for a loss and 0 for a draw
mutation at rate mu to a strategy drawn uniformly
the values a = 1, b = 1.5 and the noise intensity are chosen for the example
